This public, versioned resource maps the approved-drug target landscape from the paper supplements and adds normalized drug–target relationships, target-class browsing, a separately sourced clinical pilot, and an initial U.S. FDA primary-indication layer. FDA indication coverage is partial: as of October 13, 2026, 164 of 1,766 catalog drugs have a verified earliest indication; 1,602 remain pending review. Pending records are not evidence that a drug lacks FDA approval. The clinical pilot is selected rather than comprehensive, and its outcome records should be read with their linked evidence.

<div id="landscape-app" class="landscape-app">
  <div id="landscape-metrics" class="landscape-metrics"></div>
  <section class="landscape-panel landscape-attribution" aria-label="Data sources">
    <p><strong>Paper baseline:</strong> <a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41573-026-01530-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><em>The evolving landscape of drug targets</em></a>. This release also adds a separately sourced clinical pilot and a primary-indication layer sourced from FDA approval records and labels.</p>
    <details><summary>What has been added, and what is still uncertain?</summary>
      <p class="landscape-muted">Beyond the paper supplements, this release adds normalized target and drug identifiers, primary/secondary target roles, target-protein classification, registry-linked clinical programs and trial protocols (including one merged <a href="https://clinicaltrials.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ClinicalTrials.gov</a> NCT alias), outcome-review records, coverage-quality reporting, and an initial indication-level U.S. FDA layer for selected drugs. The cards above show current release counts. When a drug's primary mechanism cannot be assigned to one protein, it appears under an explicit unclear-target entry rather than a speculative protein. Clinical records are a separate, selected pilot evidence layer, not paper-derived data; their outcome evidence also draws on linked publications, sponsor disclosures, and regulatory records.</p>
      <p class="landscape-muted"><strong>Interpretation limits:</strong> Target classes include non-core and unresolved-scope records, so all-target counts are not the paper's approved-target count. Approval records belong to drugs, not automatically to every linked protein or indication. Clinical event labels describe cited trial or program events, not unique failed drugs or proof that a protein target failed. Nine pilot programs remain held from headline analyses pending evidence review; an unknown stopping cause remains unknown.</p>
      <p class="landscape-muted"><strong>Construction note:</strong> AI-assisted extraction, coding, and drafting contributed to this resource. The release passed scripted data and source-link checks, but its selected clinical pilot is not a systematic review; verify consequential interpretations against the linked primary sources.</p>
    </details>
  </section>
  <nav class="landscape-jump-nav" aria-label="Explore this dashboard"><button type="button" data-jump="target-explorer">Browse target classes</button><button type="button" data-jump="drug-explorer-title">Find a drug</button><button type="button" data-jump="landscape-analytics-title">See analyses</button><button type="button" data-jump="clinical-explorer">Clinical pilot</button></nav>

A counts target records across all scopes, including non-core records; B counts primary drug–target relationships; C counts each drug once at its earliest dated approval record in the paper-derived release, not necessarily its first worldwide approval; D counts outcome event records in included pilot programs, not unique drug failures. .landscape-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef4f8; padding: .2rem .5rem; font-size: .78rem; }
.reason-filter { border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; }
.reason-filter.active { background: #17324d; color: #fff; }
@media (max-width: 800px) { .landscape-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .landscape-toolbar { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; } }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .analysis-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(3.5rem, 1.3fr) max-content; gap: .3rem; } }
@media (max-width: 800px) { .target-browser { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .target-detail { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid #edf0f2; padding: 1rem 0 0; } }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  const formatNumber = (value) => new Intl.NumberFormat().format(value || 0);
  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[char]);
  document.querySelectorAll(".landscape-jump-nav [data-jump]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const destination = document.getElementById(button.dataset.jump);
    if (!destination) return;
    const collapsed = destination.closest("details:not([open])");
    if (collapsed) collapsed.open = true;
    destination.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }));
  const readableLabel = (value) => String(value || "unknown").replaceAll("_", " ");
  const phaseLabel = (value) => /^phase_[123]$/.test(value || "") ? `Phase ${value.slice(-1)}` : readableLabel(value);
  const programOutcomeBadges = (events, program) => {
    const held = program.inclusion_status !== "included";
    const labels = held ? events.map((event) => {
      const trialId = /^OUT-(NCT\d{8})$/.exec(event.outcome_event_id || "")?.[1];
      return `${readableLabel(event.event_type)}${trialId ? ` · ${trialId}` : ""}`;
    }) : [...new Set(events.map((event) => readableLabel(event.event_type)))];
    return labels.map((label) => `<span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`).join(" ") || "—";
  };
  const metricsEl = document.getElementById("landscape-metrics");
  const analyticsEl = document.getElementById("landscape-analytics-grid");
  const matrixEl = document.getElementById("phase-outcome-matrix");
  const developmentMapEl = document.getElementById("target-development-map");
  const resultsEl = document.getElementById("target-results");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("landscape-status");
  const evidenceEl = document.getElementById("evidence-results");
  const groupsEl = document.getElementById("protein-groups");
  const groupTitleEl = document.getElementById("selected-group-title");
  const groupClinicalShortcutEl = document.getElementById("group-clinical-shortcut");
  const groupTargetsEl = document.getElementById("group-targets");
  const detailEl = document.getElementById("target-detail");
  const searchEl = document.getElementById("target-search");
  const scopeEl = document.getElementById("target-scope");
  const drugSearchEl = document.getElementById("drug-search");
  const drugYearEl = document.getElementById("drug-year");
  const drugExportEl = document.getElementById("drug-export");
  const drugResultsEl = document.getElementById("drug-results");
  const clinicalEl = document.getElementById("clinical-program-results");
  const clinicalInclusionEl = document.getElementById("clinical-inclusion");
  const clinicalGroupEl = document.getElementById("clinical-group");
  const clinicalPhaseEl = document.getElementById("clinical-phase");
  const clinicalOutcomeEl = document.getElementById("clinical-outcome");
  const clinicalModalityEl = document.getElementById("clinical-modality");
  const clinicalQueryEl = document.getElementById("clinical-query");
  const clinicalResetEl = document.getElementById("clinical-reset");
  const clinicalExportEl = document.getElementById("clinical-export");
  const clinicalFilterFields = [
    ["clinical_status", clinicalInclusionEl, "included"],
    ["clinical_group", clinicalGroupEl, "all"],
    ["clinical_phase", clinicalPhaseEl, "all"],
    ["clinical_outcome", clinicalOutcomeEl, "all"],
    ["clinical_modality", clinicalModalityEl, "all"]
  ];
  const restoreClinicalFilters = (params) => {
    clinicalFilterFields.forEach(([key, select, fallback]) => {
      const requested = params.get(key);
      select.value = requested && [...select.options].some((option) => option.value === requested) ? requested : fallback;
    });
    clinicalQueryEl.value = (params.get("clinical_query") || "").slice(0, 120);
    if (clinicalFilterFields.some(([key]) => params.has(key)) || params.has("clinical_query")) {
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical > details").open = true;
    }
  };
  const updateClinicalHash = () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, ""));
    clinicalFilterFields.forEach(([key, select, fallback]) => {
      if (select.value === fallback) params.delete(key); else params.set(key, select.value);
    });
    const query = clinicalQueryEl.value.trim();
    if (query) params.set("clinical_query", query); else params.delete("clinical_query");
    history.replaceState(null, "", `#${params.toString()}`);
  };
  let payload;
  let selectedGroup = "All";
  let selectedScope = "all";
  let selectedTargetId = null;
  let evidenceFilter = "all";
  let targetResultsVisible = 50;
  let drugResultsVisible = 25;
  let firstApprovalYearByDrug = new Map();
  let evidenceVisible = 12;
  let currentClinicalPrograms = [];
  let currentDrugMatches = [];
  let focusedDrugId = null;

  const groupOrder = ["Enzymes", "GPCRs", "Ion channels", "Catalytic receptors", "Other proteins", "Endogenous peptides", "Transporters", "Nuclear hormone receptors"];
  const updateDrugHash = () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, ""));
    if (focusedDrugId) {
      params.set("drug", focusedDrugId);
      params.delete("drug_year");
    } else {
      params.delete("drug");
      if (drugYearEl.value === "all") params.delete("drug_year"); else params.set("drug_year", drugYearEl.value);
    }
    history.replaceState(null, "", `#${params.toString()}`);
  };
  const downloadCsv = (filenamePrefix, headers, rows) => {
    const csvCell = (value) => {
      let text = String(value ?? "");
      if (/^\s*[=+\-@]/.test(text)) text = `'${text}`;
      return `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
    };
    const csv = "\uFEFF" + [headers, ...rows].map((row) => row.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }));
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${filenamePrefix}-${String(payload.release.version || "release").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.-]/g, "-")}-filtered.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  };

  const renderMetrics = () => {
    const m = payload.metrics;
    const cards = [
      [m.core_targets, "paper-comparable core targets"],
      [m.approval_table_drugs, "approval-table drugs"],
      [m.drug_target_relationships, "drug-target relationships"],
      [m.approval_events, "approval events"],
      [m.cgt_only_targets, "CGT-only targets"],
      [payload.programs.length, "registry-linked clinical programs"],
      [payload.programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included").length, "included clinical programs"],
      [payload.trials.length, "linked trial protocols"]
    ];
    metricsEl.innerHTML = cards.map(([value, label]) => `<div class="landscape-metric"><span class="landscape-metric-value">${formatNumber(value)}</span><span class="landscape-metric-label">${label}</span></div>`).join("");
  };

  const renderAnalytics = () => {
    const scopeLabels = { core: "Paper-comparable core", clinical_only: "Clinical-only", cgt_only: "Cell/gene therapy-only", unresolved: "Unresolved scope" };
    const scopeCounts = payload.targets.reduce((counts, target) => { const scope = target.landscape_scope || "unresolved"; counts[scope] = (counts[scope] || 0) + 1; return counts; }, {});
    const scopeRows = ["core", "unresolved", "cgt_only", "clinical_only"].map((scope) => ({ label: scopeLabels[scope], scope, value: scopeCounts[scope] || 0, note: "target records in this release" }));
    const classStats = {};
    payload.targets.forEach((target) => {
      const group = target.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      classStats[group] = classStats[group] || { targets: 0, drugs: new Set(), clinical: 0 };
      classStats[group].targets += 1;
    });
    payload.drug_targets.forEach((link) => {
      const target = payload.targets.find((item) => item.target_id === link.target_id);
      const group = target?.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      classStats[group] = classStats[group] || { targets: 0, drugs: new Set(), clinical: 0 };
      classStats[group].drugs.add(link.drug_id);
    });
    payload.programs.forEach((program) => {
      const target = payload.targets.find((item) => item.target_id === program.primary_target_id);
      const group = target?.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      classStats[group] = classStats[group] || { targets: 0, drugs: new Set(), clinical: 0 };
      classStats[group].clinical += 1;
    });
    const classRows = Object.entries(classStats).map(([label, value]) => ({ label, group: label, value: value.targets, note: `${formatNumber(value.drugs.size)} drugs · ${formatNumber(value.clinical)} clinical` })).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
    const primaryCounts = {};
    payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => link.target_role === "primary").forEach((link) => { (primaryCounts[link.target_id] ||= new Set()).add(link.drug_id); });
    const topTargets = payload.targets.map((target) => ({ label: target.gene_symbol || target.preferred_name, target: target.target_id, value: primaryCounts[target.target_id]?.size || 0, note: target.preferred_name })).filter((row) => row.value > 0).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value || a.label.localeCompare(b.label)).slice(0, 50);
    const approvalDrugYears = new Map();
    firstApprovalYearByDrug.forEach((year, drugId) => {
      if (!approvalDrugYears.has(year)) approvalDrugYears.set(year, new Set());
      approvalDrugYears.get(year).add(drugId);
    });
    const approvalRows = [...approvalDrugYears.entries()].map(([year, drugs]) => ({ label: year, year, value: drugs.size, note: "distinct drugs with this first documented approval year" })).sort((a, b) => Number(a.label) - Number(b.label));
    const includedPrograms = payload.programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included");
    const phaseCounts = includedPrograms.reduce((acc, program) => { const key = program.lifecycle_status || "unknown"; acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {});
    const phaseRows = Object.entries(phaseCounts).map(([phase, value]) => ({ label: phaseLabel(phase), phase, value, note: "pilot clinical programs at this stage" })).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
    const includedProgramIds = new Set(includedPrograms.map((program) => program.program_id));
    const includedOutcomes = payload.outcomes.filter((outcome) => includedProgramIds.has(outcome.program_id));
    const outcomeCounts = includedOutcomes.reduce((acc, outcome) => { const key = outcome.event_type || "unknown"; acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {});
    const outcomeRows = Object.entries(outcomeCounts).map(([outcome, value]) => ({ label: readableLabel(outcome).replace(/\b[a-z]/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase()), outcome, value, note: "included pilot outcome event records; drill-down shows matching programs" })).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
    const renderBars = (rows, formatter = formatNumber) => {
      const max = Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.value), 1);
      const scale = `<div class="analysis-scale" aria-label="Color scale from lower to higher values"><span>Low</span><span class="analysis-scale-swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>High</span></div>`;
      return scale + rows.map((row) => { const ratio = row.value / max; const lightness = Math.round(88 - ratio * 48); const color = `hsl(198 58% ${lightness}%)`; const control = row.scope ? `data-analysis-scope="${escapeHtml(row.scope)}" aria-label="Browse ${formatNumber(row.value)} ${escapeHtml(row.label)} target records"` : row.group ? `data-analysis-group="${escapeHtml(row.group)}" aria-label="Open ${escapeHtml(row.group)} target class"` : row.target ? `data-analysis-target="${escapeHtml(row.target)}" aria-label="Open ${escapeHtml(row.note)} target profile"` : row.year ? `data-analysis-year="${escapeHtml(row.year)}" aria-label="Browse ${formatNumber(row.value)} drugs first documented in ${escapeHtml(row.year)}"` : row.phase ? `data-analysis-phase="${escapeHtml(row.phase)}" aria-label="Browse ${formatNumber(row.value)} ${escapeHtml(row.label)} pilot program${row.value === 1 ? "" : "s"}"` : row.outcome ? `data-analysis-outcome="${escapeHtml(row.outcome)}" aria-label="Browse programs with ${escapeHtml(row.label)} outcome events"` : ""; const tag = control ? "button" : "div"; const attrs = control ? ` type="button" class="analysis-row analysis-row-button" ${control}` : ` class="analysis-row"`; return `<${tag}${attrs} title="${escapeHtml(row.note)}"><span class="analysis-label">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</span><span class="analysis-track"><span class="analysis-bar" style="width:${Math.max(2, ratio * 100)}%;--bar-color:${color}"></span></span><span class="analysis-value">${formatter(row.value)}</span></${tag}>`; }).join("");
    };
    analyticsEl.innerHTML = `<article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Target records by coverage scope"><h3>Target records by coverage scope</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">${formatNumber(payload.targets.length)} total records · click a bar to browse that scope. Only the core is paper-comparable</p>${renderBars(scopeRows)}</article><article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Targets by protein class"><h3>Targets by protein class</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">All scopes by target count; clinical annotations cover all review states · click a bar to browse targets</p>${renderBars(classRows)}</article><article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Most connected primary targets"><h3>Most connected primary targets</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">Primary drug-target relationships · click a bar for its target profile</p>${renderBars(topTargets)}</article><article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Distinct drugs by first documented approval year"><h3>Drugs by first documented approval year</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">Each drug counted once, at its earliest dated approval record in this paper-derived release; click a bar to browse drugs. Not a complete global approval time series</p>${renderBars(approvalRows)}</article><article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Clinical programs by development stage"><h3>Clinical programs by stage</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">${formatNumber(includedPrograms.length)} included programs; ${formatNumber(payload.programs.length - includedPrograms.length)} held from headline analysis · click a bar to browse included programs</p>${renderBars(phaseRows)}</article><article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Outcome event labels in included programs"><h3>Outcome event labels in included programs</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">${formatNumber(includedOutcomes.length)} event records across ${formatNumber(includedProgramIds.size)} programs · click a bar to browse distinct matching programs; counts can differ</p>${renderBars(outcomeRows)}</article>`;
    const topCaption = analyticsEl.querySelector('[aria-label="Most connected primary targets"] .analysis-chart-caption');
    topCaption.textContent = "Top 50 by distinct drugs with a primary target link in this release; click a bar to open the target. This is not a ranking of all investigational therapeutics.";
    const maxTargetCount = Math.max(...topTargets.map((row) => row.value), 1);
    analyticsEl.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<article class="analysis-chart" aria-label="Primary target word cloud"><h3>Primary target word cloud</h3><p class="analysis-chart-caption">Same top 50 targets; word size reflects distinct primary-linked drugs. Select a name to open its profile.</p><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:.45rem 1rem;line-height:1.5">${topTargets.map((row) => `<button type="button" data-analysis-target="${escapeHtml(row.target)}" style="border:0;background:transparent;color:#176381;cursor:pointer;font-size:${(0.85 + 1.3 * Math.sqrt(row.value / maxTargetCount)).toFixed(2)}rem" title="${escapeHtml(row.note)}: ${formatNumber(row.value)} drugs">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</button>`).join("")}</div></article>`);
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-scope]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectedScope = button.dataset.analysisScope;
      scopeEl.value = selectedScope;
      searchEl.value = "";
      selectedGroup = "All";
      selectedTargetId = null;
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups(); renderGroupTargets(); renderTargets(); renderTargetDetail(null);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-group]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectedScope = "all";
      scopeEl.value = "all";
      searchEl.value = "";
      selectedGroup = button.dataset.analysisGroup;
      selectedTargetId = null;
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups();
      renderGroupTargets();
      renderTargets();
      renderTargetDetail(null);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-target]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = payload.targets.find((item) => item.target_id === button.dataset.analysisTarget);
      if (!target) return;
      searchEl.value = "";
      selectedTargetId = target.target_id;
      selectedGroup = target.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      alignScopeToTarget(target);
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups(); renderGroupTargets(); renderTargetDetail(target);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-year]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      focusedDrugId = null;
      drugSearchEl.value = "";
      drugYearEl.value = button.dataset.analysisYear;
      drugResultsVisible = 25;
      updateDrugHash();
      renderDrugResults();
      document.querySelector(".landscape-drugs")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
    const openChartPrograms = (phase, outcome) => {
      clinicalInclusionEl.value = "included";
      clinicalGroupEl.value = "all";
      clinicalPhaseEl.value = phase || "all";
      clinicalOutcomeEl.value = outcome || "all";
      clinicalModalityEl.value = "all";
      clinicalQueryEl.value = "";
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical > details").open = true;
      updateClinicalHash();
      renderClinicalExplorer();
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    };
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-phase]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => openChartPrograms(button.dataset.analysisPhase, null)));
    analyticsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-analysis-outcome]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => openChartPrograms(null, button.dataset.analysisOutcome)));
    const approvalDrugIds = new Set(payload.approvals.map((approval) => approval.drug_id));
    const mapRows = payload.targets.map((target) => {
      const links = payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => link.target_id === target.target_id);
      const drugIds = new Set(links.map((link) => link.drug_id));
      return { target, approved: [...drugIds].filter((drugId) => approvalDrugIds.has(drugId)).length, clinical: includedPrograms.filter((program) => program.primary_target_id === target.target_id).length, primary: links.filter((link) => link.target_role === "primary").length };
    }).filter((row) => row.approved > 0 || row.clinical > 0).sort((a, b) => (b.approved + b.clinical * 3) - (a.approved + a.clinical * 3)).slice(0, 40);
    const width = 760; const height = 300; const left = 62; const right = 18; const top = 18; const bottom = 52;
    const maxApproved = Math.max(...mapRows.map((row) => row.approved), 1); const maxClinical = Math.max(...mapRows.map((row) => row.clinical), 1);
    const x = (value) => left + (value / maxApproved) * (width - left - right); const y = (value) => height - bottom - (value / maxClinical) * (height - top - bottom);
    const xTicks = [0, Math.ceil(maxApproved / 2), maxApproved].filter((value, index, values) => values.indexOf(value) === index);
    const yTicks = [0, Math.ceil(maxClinical / 2), maxClinical].filter((value, index, values) => values.indexOf(value) === index);
    const grid = [...xTicks.map((tick) => `<line class="development-map-grid" x1="${x(tick)}" x2="${x(tick)}" y1="${top}" y2="${height - bottom}"></line><text class="development-map-label" x="${x(tick)}" y="${height - bottom + 18}" text-anchor="middle">${tick}</text>`), ...yTicks.map((tick) => `<line class="development-map-grid" x1="${left}" x2="${width - right}" y1="${y(tick)}" y2="${y(tick)}"></line><text class="development-map-label" x="${left - 8}" y="${y(tick) + 4}" text-anchor="end">${tick}</text>`)].join("");
    const maxPrimary = Math.max(...mapRows.map((row) => row.primary), 1);
    const points = mapRows.map((row) => { const radius = Math.max(4, Math.min(11, 3 + Math.sqrt(row.primary || 1))); const pointColor = `hsl(198 58% ${Math.round(82 - (row.primary / maxPrimary) * 42)}%)`; const label = `${row.target.preferred_name}: ${row.approved} approved drugs, ${row.clinical} included clinical programs`; return `<a href="#target=${encodeURIComponent(row.target.target_id)}"><circle class="development-map-point" style="fill:${pointColor}" cx="${x(row.approved)}" cy="${y(row.clinical)}" r="${radius}" aria-label="${label}"><title>${label}</title></circle></a>`; }).join("");
    developmentMapEl.innerHTML = `<h3>Target development map</h3><p>Targets with the broadest approved-drug or included clinical-program footprint. Held programs are excluded from this plot. Click a point to open its target profile.</p><svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-label="Scatter plot comparing approved drugs and included clinical programs per target"><title>Target development map</title><desc>Horizontal axis shows approved drugs; vertical axis shows included clinical programs.</desc>${grid}<line class="development-map-axis" x1="${left}" x2="${width - right}" y1="${height - bottom}" y2="${height - bottom}"></line><line class="development-map-axis" x1="${left}" x2="${left}" y1="${top}" y2="${height - bottom}"></line>${points}<text class="development-map-label" x="${(left + width - right) / 2}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle">Approved drugs</text><text class="development-map-label" transform="translate(15 ${(top + height - bottom) / 2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle">Included clinical programs</text></svg>`;
  };

  const renderPhaseOutcomeMatrix = () => {
    const included = payload.programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included");
    const programById = new Map(included.map((program) => [program.program_id, program]));
    const phases = ["phase_1", "phase_2", "phase_3"].filter((phase) => included.some((program) => program.lifecycle_status === phase));
    const cells = new Map();
    const outcomePrograms = new Map();
    payload.outcomes.forEach((outcome) => {
      const program = programById.get(outcome.program_id);
      if (!program || !phases.includes(program.lifecycle_status)) return;
      const key = `${program.lifecycle_status}|${outcome.event_type}`;
      if (!cells.has(key)) cells.set(key, new Set());
      cells.get(key).add(program.program_id);
      if (!outcomePrograms.has(outcome.event_type)) outcomePrograms.set(outcome.event_type, new Set());
      outcomePrograms.get(outcome.event_type).add(program.program_id);
    });
    const outcomeTypes = [...outcomePrograms.keys()].sort((a, b) => outcomePrograms.get(b).size - outcomePrograms.get(a).size || a.localeCompare(b));
    const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...[...cells.values()].map((programIds) => programIds.size));
    const headers = phases.map((phase) => `<th scope="col">${escapeHtml(phaseLabel(phase))}</th>`).join("");
    const rows = outcomeTypes.map((outcome) => `<tr><th scope="row" class="outcome-name">${escapeHtml(readableLabel(outcome))}</th>${phases.map((phase) => {
      const count = cells.get(`${phase}|${outcome}`)?.size || 0;
      if (!count) return '<td><span class="phase-outcome-zero" aria-label="0 programs">0</span></td>';
      const lightness = Math.round(90 - (count / maxCount) * 47);
      const foreground = lightness < 55 ? "#fff" : "#17324d";
      const label = `${count} included ${phaseLabel(phase)} program${count === 1 ? "" : "s"} with ${readableLabel(outcome)} outcome label; open filtered programs`;
      return `<td><button type="button" class="phase-outcome-cell" data-matrix-phase="${escapeHtml(phase)}" data-matrix-outcome="${escapeHtml(outcome)}" style="background:hsl(198 58% ${lightness}%);color:${foreground}" aria-label="${escapeHtml(label)}">${count}</button></td>`;
    }).join("")}</tr>`).join("");
    matrixEl.innerHTML = `<h3>Program stage × outcome label</h3><p>${formatNumber(included.length)} included programs · distinct programs per cell. One program may appear in multiple outcome rows. Stage describes the program, not necessarily the phase of the cited outcome event.</p><div class="phase-outcome-wrap" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scrollable phase and outcome matrix"><table class="phase-outcome-table" aria-label="Included clinical programs by program stage and curated outcome label"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Outcome label</th>${headers}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div><div class="phase-outcome-legend"><span>Fewer</span><span class="phase-outcome-swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>More programs</span></div>`;
    matrixEl.querySelectorAll("[data-matrix-phase]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      clinicalInclusionEl.value = "included";
      clinicalGroupEl.value = "all";
      clinicalPhaseEl.value = button.dataset.matrixPhase;
      clinicalOutcomeEl.value = button.dataset.matrixOutcome;
      clinicalModalityEl.value = "all";
      clinicalQueryEl.value = "";
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical > details").open = true;
      updateClinicalHash();
      renderClinicalExplorer();
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
  };

  const renderClinicalExplorer = () => {
    const targetById = new Map(payload.targets.map((target) => [target.target_id, target]));
    const drugById = new Map(payload.drugs.map((drug) => [drug.drug_id, drug]));
    const sourceById = new Map(payload.sources.map((source) => [source.source_id, source]));
    const outcomesByProgram = new Map();
    payload.outcomes.forEach((outcome) => {
      if (!outcomesByProgram.has(outcome.program_id)) outcomesByProgram.set(outcome.program_id, []);
      outcomesByProgram.get(outcome.program_id).push(outcome);
    });
    const trialsByProgram = new Map();
    payload.trials.forEach((trial) => {
      if (!trialsByProgram.has(trial.program_id)) trialsByProgram.set(trial.program_id, []);
      trialsByProgram.get(trial.program_id).push(trial);
    });
    const filters = {
      inclusion: clinicalInclusionEl.value,
      group: clinicalGroupEl.value,
      phase: clinicalPhaseEl.value,
      outcome: clinicalOutcomeEl.value,
      modality: clinicalModalityEl.value,
      query: clinicalQueryEl.value.trim().toLowerCase()
    };
    const programs = payload.programs.filter((program) => {
      const target = targetById.get(program.primary_target_id);
      const drug = drugById.get(program.drug_id);
      const matchesQuery = !filters.query || [drug?.preferred_name, drug?.generic_name, program.development_name, target?.preferred_name, target?.gene_symbol, program.indication_name].some((value) => String(value || "").toLowerCase().includes(filters.query));
      return (filters.inclusion === "all" || program.inclusion_status === filters.inclusion)
        && (filters.group === "all" || (target?.protein_group || "Unclassified") === filters.group)
        && (filters.phase === "all" || program.lifecycle_status === filters.phase)
        && (filters.outcome === "all" || (outcomesByProgram.get(program.program_id) || []).some((outcome) => outcome.event_type === filters.outcome))
        && (filters.modality === "all" || program.modality === filters.modality)
        && matchesQuery;
    }).sort((a, b) => (drugById.get(a.drug_id)?.preferred_name || a.development_name || "").localeCompare(drugById.get(b.drug_id)?.preferred_name || b.development_name || ""));
    currentClinicalPrograms = programs;
    clinicalExportEl.disabled = programs.length === 0;
    clinicalExportEl.textContent = `Download ${formatNumber(programs.length)} matching program${programs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} (CSV)`;
    const rows = programs.map((program) => {
      const drug = drugById.get(program.drug_id);
      const target = targetById.get(program.primary_target_id);
      const events = outcomesByProgram.get(program.program_id) || [];
      const labels = programOutcomeBadges(events, program);
      const reviewStatus = program.inclusion_status === "included" ? "Included" : "Needs review — held from headline analyses";
      const evidenceItems = events.map((event) => {
        const source = sourceById.get(event.source_id);
        const sourceText = source?.title || event.source_id || "Source not recorded";
        const sourceLink = /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? `<a href="${escapeHtml(source.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(sourceText)}</a>` : escapeHtml(sourceText);
        const qualification = [event.confidence ? `${readableLabel(event.confidence)} confidence` : "", event.stated_or_inferred ? readableLabel(event.stated_or_inferred) : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        return `<li><strong>${escapeHtml(readableLabel(event.event_type))}</strong>${qualification ? ` <span class="landscape-muted">(${escapeHtml(qualification)})</span>` : ""}: ${escapeHtml(event.description || "Description not recorded.")} <small>Evidence: ${sourceLink}</small></li>`;
      }).join("");
      const evidenceCell = `<details><summary>${formatNumber(events.length)} event${events.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</summary><ul>${evidenceItems}</ul></details>`;
      const trialLinks = (trialsByProgram.get(program.program_id) || []).map((trial) => {
        const id = trial.registry_identifier || trial.trial_id;
        const review = payload.evidence_review.find((row) => row.trial_id === trial.trial_id);
        const currentId = review?.current_registry_id || id;
        return /^NCT\d{8}$/.test(currentId) ? `<a href="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${currentId}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(id)}</a>` : escapeHtml(id);
      }).join(", ") || "—";
      const targetCell = target ? `<button type="button" class="target-table-button" data-clinical-target="${escapeHtml(target.target_id)}">${escapeHtml(target.gene_symbol || target.preferred_name)}</button>${program.target_status === "unclear" ? ' <span class="landscape-badge">unclear primary target</span>' : ""}` : "—";
      return `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(drug?.preferred_name || drug?.generic_name || program.development_name || program.drug_id)}</td><td>${targetCell}</td><td>${escapeHtml(program.indication_name || "—")}</td><td>${escapeHtml(phaseLabel(program.lifecycle_status))}</td><td>${escapeHtml(readableLabel(program.modality))}</td><td>${labels}</td><td>${escapeHtml(reviewStatus)}</td><td>${trialLinks}</td><td>${evidenceCell}</td></tr>`;
    }).join("");
    const reviewWarning = filters.inclusion !== "included" ? '<p class="landscape-muted">Needs-review programs are held from headline analyses. Some cited trial-specific outcomes are established, but they do not establish failure of every trial or the whole program. A registry status or candidate reason alone does not establish why development stopped.</p>' : "";
    clinicalEl.innerHTML = `<p role="status"><strong>${formatNumber(programs.length)}</strong> of ${formatNumber(payload.programs.length)} pilot programs match these filters.</p>${reviewWarning}<p class="landscape-muted">Scroll the table horizontally on narrow screens; expand an evidence cell for its cited outcome description.</p><div class="clinical-table-wrap" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scrollable clinical program table"><table class="landscape-table"><thead><tr><th>Drug</th><th>Primary target</th><th>Indication</th><th>Program stage</th><th>Modality</th><th>Outcome event labels</th><th>Review status</th><th>Trial protocols</th><th>Evidence</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="9">No programs match these filters.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`;
    clinicalEl.querySelectorAll("[data-clinical-target]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = targetById.get(button.dataset.clinicalTarget);
      if (!target) return;
      selectedTargetId = target.target_id;
      selectedGroup = target.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      alignScopeToTarget(target);
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups(); renderGroupTargets(); renderTargetDetail(target);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
  };

  const renderDrugResults = () => {
    const query = drugSearchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const year = drugYearEl.value;
    if (!query && year === "all") {
      currentDrugMatches = [];
      drugExportEl.disabled = true;
      drugExportEl.textContent = "Download matching drug–target links (CSV)";
      drugResultsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="landscape-muted">Enter a drug name or select an approval year to browse target relationships.</p>';
      return;
    }
    const targetById = new Map(payload.targets.map((target) => [target.target_id, target]));
    const approvalDrugIds = new Set(payload.approvals.map((approval) => approval.drug_id));
    const fdaByDrug = new Map();
    (payload.fda_approved_indications || []).forEach((record) => {
      if (!fdaByDrug.has(record.drug_id)) fdaByDrug.set(record.drug_id, []);
      fdaByDrug.get(record.drug_id).push(record);
    });
    const fdaReviewByDrug = new Map((payload.fda_primary_indication_review || []).map((record) => [record.drug_id, record.review_status]));
    const linksByDrug = new Map();
    payload.drug_targets.forEach((link) => {
      if (!linksByDrug.has(link.drug_id)) linksByDrug.set(link.drug_id, []);
      linksByDrug.get(link.drug_id).push(link);
    });
    const programsByDrug = new Map();
    payload.programs.forEach((program) => {
      if (!programsByDrug.has(program.drug_id)) programsByDrug.set(program.drug_id, []);
      programsByDrug.get(program.drug_id).push(program);
    });
    const matches = payload.drugs.filter((drug) => focusedDrugId ? drug.drug_id === focusedDrugId : (year === "all" || firstApprovalYearByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) === year) && (!query || [drug.preferred_name, drug.generic_name, ...(programsByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || []).map((program) => program.development_name)].some((name) => String(name || "").toLowerCase().includes(query))))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.preferred_name || a.generic_name || "").localeCompare(b.preferred_name || b.generic_name || ""));
    currentDrugMatches = matches;
    drugExportEl.disabled = matches.length === 0;
    drugExportEl.textContent = `Download links for ${formatNumber(matches.length)} matching drug${matches.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} (CSV)`;
    const rows = matches.slice(0, drugResultsVisible).map((drug) => {
      const links = (linksByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || []).sort((a, b) => (a.target_role === "primary" ? 0 : 1) - (b.target_role === "primary" ? 0 : 1));
      const targets = links.map((link) => {
        const target = targetById.get(link.target_id);
        if (!target) return "";
        return `<span><button type="button" class="target-table-button" data-drug-target="${escapeHtml(target.target_id)}">${escapeHtml(target.gene_symbol || target.preferred_name)}</button> <span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(readableLabel(link.target_role))}</span></span>`;
      }).filter(Boolean).join("");
      const programs = programsByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || [];
      const included = programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included").length;
      const programCell = programs.length ? `<button type="button" class="target-table-button" data-drug-programs="${escapeHtml(drug.drug_id)}">View ${formatNumber(programs.length)} pilot program${programs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</button> <span class="landscape-muted">(${formatNumber(included)} included)</span>` : "None in pilot";
      const approvalYear = firstApprovalYearByDrug.get(drug.drug_id);
      const fdaRecords = (fdaByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || []).sort((a, b) => a.approval_date.localeCompare(b.approval_date));
      const fdaPrimary = fdaRecords[0];
      const fdaReviewStatus = fdaReviewByDrug.get(drug.drug_id);
      const fdaCell = fdaPrimary ? `<details class="fda-indications"><summary>${fdaReviewStatus === "verified_primary_indication" ? "Verified earliest FDA indication" : "Earliest currently curated indication"}</summary><ul><li><strong>${escapeHtml(fdaPrimary.indication)}</strong><br>FDA approval: ${escapeHtml(fdaPrimary.approval_date)}<br>Eligible group: ${escapeHtml(fdaPrimary.qualifying_population)}<br><a href="${escapeHtml(fdaPrimary.label_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FDA label</a> · <a href="${escapeHtml(fdaPrimary.approval_source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FDA approval record</a></li></ul>${fdaReviewStatus === "verified_primary_indication" ? "" : '<p class="landscape-muted">Earliest indication review is in progress; earlier approvals may not yet be represented.</p>'}</details>` : '<span class="landscape-muted">FDA indication not yet curated</span>';
      return `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(drug.preferred_name || drug.generic_name || drug.drug_id)}</td><td>${approvalYear ? `First documented ${escapeHtml(approvalYear)}` : approvalDrugIds.has(drug.drug_id) ? "Record linked; year unknown" : "No record in this release"}</td><td>${fdaCell}</td><td><div class="drug-link-list">${targets || "No target assigned in this release"}</div></td><td>${programCell}</td></tr>`;
    }).join("");
    const remainder = matches.length - Math.min(matches.length, drugResultsVisible);
    drugResultsEl.innerHTML = `<p role="status" class="landscape-muted">Showing ${formatNumber(Math.min(matches.length, drugResultsVisible))} of ${formatNumber(matches.length)} matching drugs.</p><div class="drug-table-wrap" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scrollable drug and target table"><table class="landscape-table"><thead><tr><th>Drug</th><th>Drug-level approval record</th><th>U.S. FDA-approved indications</th><th>Linked targets and roles</th><th>Pilot programs</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="5">No drugs match this name.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>${remainder > 0 ? `<p><button type="button" class="load-more-button" id="more-drug-results">Show ${formatNumber(Math.min(25, remainder))} more drugs</button></p>` : ""}`;
    drugResultsEl.querySelector("#more-drug-results")?.addEventListener("click", () => { drugResultsVisible += 25; renderDrugResults(); });
    drugResultsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-drug-target]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = targetById.get(button.dataset.drugTarget);
      if (!target) return;
      searchEl.value = "";
      selectedTargetId = target.target_id;
      selectedGroup = target.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      alignScopeToTarget(target);
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups(); renderGroupTargets(); renderTargetDetail(target);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
    drugResultsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-drug-programs]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const drug = payload.drugs.find((row) => row.drug_id === button.dataset.drugPrograms);
      if (!drug) return;
      clinicalInclusionEl.value = "all";
      clinicalGroupEl.value = "all";
      clinicalPhaseEl.value = "all";
      clinicalOutcomeEl.value = "all";
      clinicalModalityEl.value = "all";
      clinicalQueryEl.value = drug.preferred_name || drug.generic_name || "";
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical > details").open = true;
      updateClinicalHash();
      renderClinicalExplorer();
      document.querySelector(".landscape-clinical")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
  };

  const renderTargets = () => {
    const query = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matches = payload.targets.filter((target) => !query || `${target.preferred_name} ${target.gene_symbol} ${target.uniprot_accession} ${target.protein_group}`.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    const visibleTargets = matches.slice(0, targetResultsVisible);
    const rows = visibleTargets.map((target) => `<tr><td><button class="target-table-button" data-target-id="${escapeHtml(target.target_id)}">${escapeHtml(target.preferred_name)}</button></td><td>${escapeHtml(target.gene_symbol || "—")}</td><td>${escapeHtml(target.protein_group || "—")}</td><td><span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(target.target_status)}</span></td></tr>`).join("");
    const tableOpen = "<" + "table class=\"landscape-table\">";
    const tableClose = "<" + "/table>";
    const remainder = matches.length - visibleTargets.length;
    resultsEl.innerHTML = `<p class="landscape-muted">Showing ${formatNumber(visibleTargets.length)} of ${formatNumber(matches.length)} matching targets.</p><div class="target-table-wrap" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scrollable target table">${tableOpen}<thead><tr><th>Target</th><th>Gene</th><th>Group</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="4">No matching targets.</td></tr>'}</tbody>${tableClose}</div>${remainder > 0 ? `<p><button type="button" class="load-more-button" id="more-target-results">Show ${formatNumber(Math.min(50, remainder))} more targets</button></p>` : ""}`;
    resultsEl.querySelector("#more-target-results")?.addEventListener("click", () => { targetResultsVisible += 50; renderTargets(); });
    resultsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-target-id]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectedTargetId = button.dataset.targetId;
      const target = payload.targets.find((item) => item.target_id === selectedTargetId);
      selectedGroup = target?.protein_group || "Unclassified";
      alignScopeToTarget(target);
      updateExplorerHash();
      renderProteinGroups();
      renderGroupTargets();
      renderTargetDetail(target);
      document.querySelector(".landscape-explorer")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }));
  };

  const targetDrugs = (targetId) => {
    const drugIds = new Set(payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => link.target_id === targetId).map((link) => link.drug_id));
    return payload.drugs.filter((drug) => drugIds.has(drug.drug_id));
  };

  const renderTargetDetail = (target) => {
    if (!target) {
      detailEl.innerHTML = '<p class="landscape-muted">Select a target protein to see details.</p>';
      return;
    }
    const drugs = targetDrugs(target.target_id);
    const links = payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => link.target_id === target.target_id);
    const approvedDrugIds = new Set(payload.approvals.map((approval) => approval.drug_id));
    const approvedDrugs = drugs.filter((drug) => approvedDrugIds.has(drug.drug_id));
    const otherLinkedDrugs = drugs.filter((drug) => !approvedDrugIds.has(drug.drug_id));
    const targetRoles = new Map(links.map((link) => [link.drug_id, link.target_role]));
    const drugName = (drug) => drug.preferred_name || drug.generic_name || drug.drug_id;
    const drugRows = (items) => items.sort((a, b) => drugName(a).localeCompare(drugName(b))).map((drug) => `<li><button type="button" class="target-table-button" data-detail-drug="${escapeHtml(drug.drug_id)}" aria-label="Explore all targets linked to ${escapeHtml(drugName(drug))}">${escapeHtml(drugName(drug))}</button> <span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(targetRoles.get(drug.drug_id) || "role unclear")} target</span></li>`).join("");
    const primaryLinks = links.filter((link) => link.target_role === "primary");
    const secondaryLinks = links.filter((link) => link.target_role !== "primary");
    const drugIds = new Set(drugs.map((drug) => drug.drug_id));
    const relatedTargetLinks = payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => drugIds.has(link.drug_id) && link.target_id !== target.target_id);
    const relatedTargetIds = new Set(relatedTargetLinks.map((link) => link.target_id));
    const relatedTargets = payload.targets.filter((item) => relatedTargetIds.has(item.target_id)).sort((a, b) => (a.preferred_name || "").localeCompare(b.preferred_name || ""));
    const approvals = payload.approvals.filter((approval) => drugIds.has(approval.drug_id));
    const programs = payload.programs.filter((program) => program.primary_target_id === target.target_id);
    const outcomes = payload.outcomes.filter((outcome) => programs.some((program) => program.program_id === outcome.program_id));
    const timeline = [];
    const firstApprovalByDrug = new Map();
    approvals.forEach((approval) => {
      const year = String(approval.approval_date || "").slice(0, 4);
      if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(year)) return;
      const previous = firstApprovalByDrug.get(approval.drug_id);
      if (!previous || year < previous.year) firstApprovalByDrug.set(approval.drug_id, { year, sourceId: approval.source_id });
    });
    drugs.forEach((drug) => {
      const firstApproval = firstApprovalByDrug.get(drug.drug_id);
      const source = payload.sources.find((item) => item.source_id === firstApproval?.sourceId);
      if (firstApproval) timeline.push({ date: firstApproval.year, sortDate: `${firstApproval.year}-01-01`, type: "approval", label: `${drugName(drug)} — drug's first recorded approval year (${targetRoles.get(drug.drug_id) || "unclear"} target link)`, link: /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? source.url : "" });
    });
    programs.forEach((program) => {
      const drug = payload.drugs.find((item) => item.drug_id === program.drug_id);
      const name = drug ? drugName(drug) : program.development_name || program.drug_id;
      payload.trials.filter((trial) => trial.program_id === program.program_id).forEach((trial) => {
        const evidence = payload.evidence_review.find((row) => row.trial_id === trial.trial_id);
        const registryId = evidence?.current_registry_id || trial.registry_identifier;
        const link = /^NCT\d{8}$/.test(registryId || "") ? `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${registryId}` : "";
        [[trial.start_date, "study start"], [trial.primary_completion_date, "primary completion"]].forEach(([date, milestone]) => {
          if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}(-\d{2})?$/.test(date || "")) timeline.push({ date, sortDate: date.length === 7 ? `${date}-01` : date, type: "trial", label: `${name} — ${milestone} (${trial.registry_identifier || trial.trial_id})`, link });
        });
      });
      outcomes.filter((outcome) => outcome.program_id === program.program_id).forEach((outcome) => {
        const date = outcome.event_date || "";
        const source = payload.sources.find((item) => item.source_id === outcome.source_id);
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}(-\d{2})?$/.test(date)) timeline.push({ date, sortDate: date.length === 7 ? `${date}-01` : date, type: "outcome", label: `${name} — ${readableLabel(outcome.event_type)} event${program.inclusion_status === "included" ? "" : " (needs review)"}`, note: outcome.description || "", link: /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? source.url : "" });
      });
    });
    timeline.sort((a, b) => a.sortDate.localeCompare(b.sortDate) || a.type.localeCompare(b.type) || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
    const timelineRows = timeline.map((item) => `<li><time datetime="${escapeHtml(item.date)}">${escapeHtml(item.date)}</time> <span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(item.type)}</span> ${escapeHtml(item.label)}${item.link ? ` <a href="${escapeHtml(item.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Source</a>` : ""}${item.note ? `<small>${escapeHtml(item.note)}</small>` : ""}</li>`).join("");
    const includedProgramIds = new Set(programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included").map((program) => program.program_id));
    const needsReviewCount = programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status !== "included").length;
    const outcomeCounts = outcomes.filter((outcome) => includedProgramIds.has(outcome.program_id)).reduce((acc, outcome) => { const key = outcome.event_type || "unknown"; acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {});
    const sourceIds = new Set([...outcomes.map((outcome) => outcome.source_id), ...links.map((link) => link.source_id), ...approvals.map((approval) => approval.source_id)].filter(Boolean));
    const evidenceSources = [...sourceIds].map((id) => payload.sources.find((source) => source.source_id === id)).filter(Boolean);
    const clinicalRows = programs.map((program) => {
      const programTrials = payload.trials.filter((trial) => trial.program_id === program.program_id);
      const trialText = programTrials.map((trial) => { const id = trial.registry_identifier || trial.trial_id; const evidence = payload.evidence_review.find((row) => row.trial_id === trial.trial_id); const currentId = evidence?.current_registry_id || id; const aliasNote = evidence?.registry_id_role === "merged_alias" ? " · merged NCT alias" : ""; const link = /^NCT\d{8}$/.test(currentId || "") ? `<a href="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${currentId}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(id)}</a>` : escapeHtml(id); return `${link} (${escapeHtml(readableLabel(trial.recruitment_status || "status unknown"))}${aliasNote})`; }).join(", ") || "No trial linked";
      const programOutcomes = outcomes.filter((outcome) => outcome.program_id === program.program_id);
      const outcomeLabels = programOutcomeBadges(programOutcomes, program);
      const outcomeItems = programOutcomes.map((outcome) => {
        const source = payload.sources.find((item) => item.source_id === outcome.source_id);
        const sourceText = source?.title || outcome.source_id || "Source not recorded";
        const sourceLink = /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? `<a href="${escapeHtml(source.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(sourceText)}</a>` : escapeHtml(sourceText);
        const qualification = [outcome.confidence ? `${readableLabel(outcome.confidence)} confidence` : "", outcome.stated_or_inferred ? readableLabel(outcome.stated_or_inferred) : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        return `<li><strong>${escapeHtml(readableLabel(outcome.event_type))}</strong>${qualification ? ` <span class="landscape-muted">(${escapeHtml(qualification)})</span>` : ""}: ${escapeHtml(outcome.description || "Description not recorded.")} <small>Evidence: ${sourceLink}</small></li>`;
      }).join("");
      const outcomeEvidence = programOutcomes.length ? `<details class="program-evidence"><summary>Outcome evidence (${formatNumber(programOutcomes.length)})</summary><ul>${outcomeItems}</ul></details>` : '<small>No outcome event curated for this program.</small>';
      const drug = payload.drugs.find((item) => item.drug_id === program.drug_id);
      return `<li>${escapeHtml(drug?.preferred_name || drug?.generic_name || program.drug_id.replace(/^DRG-/, ""))} <span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(readableLabel(program.lifecycle_status || "phase unknown"))}</span> <span class="landscape-badge">${escapeHtml(readableLabel(program.inclusion_status || "review status unknown"))}</span> ${outcomeLabels}${program.inclusion_status !== "included" ? '<small>Held from headline analyses; event labels do not establish whole-program failure.</small>' : ""}<small>Indication: ${escapeHtml(program.indication_name || "not recorded")}</small><small>Trials: ${trialText}</small>${program.target_status === "unclear" ? '<small>Primary protein unresolved; outcome events are not assigned to a specific protein.</small>' : ""}${outcomeEvidence}</li>`;
    }).join("");

    const reviewWarning = needsReviewCount ? `<p class="landscape-muted">${formatNumber(needsReviewCount)} program${needsReviewCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} ${needsReviewCount === 1 ? "remains" : "remain"} held from headline analyses. Trial-specific findings may still be supported, but they are excluded from the summary counts and do not establish whole-program failure.</p>` : "";

    const relatedTargetList = relatedTargets.map((relatedTarget) => `<li><a href="#target=${encodeURIComponent(relatedTarget.target_id)}">${escapeHtml(relatedTarget.preferred_name)}</a>${relatedTarget.gene_symbol ? ` <span class="landscape-muted">(${escapeHtml(relatedTarget.gene_symbol)})</span>` : ""}</li>`).join("");

    const coTargetPrograms = payload.programs.filter((program) => drugIds.has(program.drug_id) && program.primary_target_id?.startsWith("TGT-unknown-") && program.primary_target_id !== target.target_id);
    if (coTargetPrograms.length) {

    const drugCounts = payload.drug_targets.reduce((acc, link) => {

    const allDrugCount = new Set(payload.drug_targets.filter((link) => scopedIds.has(link.target_id)).map((link) => link.drug_id)).size;
    const allClinicalCount = payload.programs.filter((program) => scopedIds.has(program.primary_target_id)).length;
    groupsEl.innerHTML = groups.map((group) => { const targetCount = group === "All" ? scopedTargets.length : counts[group] || 0; const linkedDrugCount = group === "All" ? allDrugCount : (drugCounts[group]?.size || 0); const clinicalCount = group === "All" ? allClinicalCount : clinicalCounts[group] || 0; return `<button class="protein-group-button${group === selectedGroup ? " active" : ""}" data-group="${escapeHtml(group)}" aria-controls="group-targets" aria-pressed="${group === selectedGroup}">${escapeHtml(group)}<span class="protein-group-count">${formatNumber(targetCount)} targets · ${formatNumber(linkedDrugCount)} drugs · ${formatNumber(clinicalCount)} clinical</span></button>`; }).join("");

"all evidence" : key; return `<button class="landscape-badge reason-filter${evidenceFilter === key ? " active" : ""}" data-reason="${escapeHtml(key)}" aria-pressed="${evidenceFilter === key}">${escapeHtml(label)}: ${formatNumber(value)}</button>`; }).join(" ");
    const filteredRows = rows.filter((row) => row.why_stopped && (evidenceFilter === "all" || (row.candidate_reason || "no_registry_reason") === evidenceFilter));

      return `<tr><td>${trialCell}</td><td>${targetCell}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.candidate_reason || "—")}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.candidate_confidence || "—")}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.why_stopped)}</td></tr>`;

        if (!firstYear || year < firstYear) firstApprovalYearByDrug.set(approval.drug_id, year);
      });

      const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, ""));

    const linksByDrug = new Map();
    payload.drug_targets.forEach((link) => {
      if (!linksByDrug.has(link.drug_id)) linksByDrug.set(link.drug_id, []);
      linksByDrug.get(link.drug_id).push(link);
    });
    const programsByDrug = new Map();
    payload.programs.forEach((program) => {
      if (!programsByDrug.has(program.drug_id)) programsByDrug.set(program.drug_id, []);
      programsByDrug.get(program.drug_id).push(program);
    });
    const headers = ["release_version", "release_as_of", "drug_id", "drug_name", "generic_name", "drug_modality", "drug_source_name", "drug_has_approval_record", "first_documented_approval_year", "drug_pilot_program_count", "drug_included_pilot_program_count", "drug_target_link_id", "target_id", "target_name", "target_gene", "target_class", "target_scope", "target_role", "moa_status", "evidence_grade", "link_source_id", "link_source_title", "link_source_url"];
    const rows = currentDrugMatches.flatMap((drug) => {
      const programs = programsByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || [];
      const base = [payload.release.version, payload.release.as_of_date, drug.drug_id, drug.preferred_name, drug.generic_name, drug.modality, drug.source_name, approvalDrugIds.has(drug.drug_id) ? "yes" : "no", firstApprovalYearByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || "", programs.length, programs.filter((program) => program.inclusion_status === "included").length];
      return (linksByDrug.get(drug.drug_id) || [null]).map((link) => {
        const target = link ? targetById.get(link.target_id) : null;
        const source = link ? sourceById.get(link.source_id) : null;
        return [...base, link?.drug_target_id || "", link?.target_id || "", target?.preferred_name || "", target?.gene_symbol || "", target?.protein_group || "", target?.landscape_scope || "", link?.target_role || "", link?.moa_status || "", link?.evidence_grade || "", link?.source_id || "", source?.title || "", /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? source.url : ""];
      });
    });
    downloadCsv("drug-target-links", headers, rows);
  });
  [clinicalInclusionEl, clinicalGroupEl, clinicalPhaseEl, clinicalOutcomeEl, clinicalModalityEl].forEach((select) => select.addEventListener("change", () => { if (payload) { updateClinicalHash(); renderClinicalExplorer(); } }));
  clinicalQueryEl.addEventListener("input", () => { if (payload) { updateClinicalHash(); renderClinicalExplorer(); } });
  clinicalResetEl.addEventListener("click", () => {
    clinicalFilterFields.forEach(([, select, fallback]) => { select.value = fallback; });
    clinicalQueryEl.value = "";
    if (payload) { updateClinicalHash(); renderClinicalExplorer(); }
  });
  clinicalExportEl.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!payload || !currentClinicalPrograms.length) return;
    const drugById = new Map(payload.drugs.map((drug) => [drug.drug_id, drug]));
    const targetById = new Map(payload.targets.map((target) => [target.target_id, target]));
    const sourceById = new Map(payload.sources.map((source) => [source.source_id, source]));
    const trialsByProgram = new Map();
    payload.trials.forEach((trial) => {
      if (!trialsByProgram.has(trial.program_id)) trialsByProgram.set(trial.program_id, []);
      trialsByProgram.get(trial.program_id).push(trial);
    });
    const outcomesByProgram = new Map();
    payload.outcomes.forEach((outcome) => {
      if (!outcomesByProgram.has(outcome.program_id)) outcomesByProgram.set(outcome.program_id, []);
      outcomesByProgram.get(outcome.program_id).push(outcome);
    });
    const headers = ["release_version", "release_as_of", "program_id", "drug_id", "drug_name", "development_name", "primary_target_id", "target_gene", "target_name", "target_class", "target_scope", "target_status", "indication", "program_stage", "modality", "review_status", "trial_identifiers", "outcome_event_id", "outcome_type", "outcome_date", "outcome_description", "reason_stated_or_inferred", "outcome_confidence", "evidence_source_id", "evidence_url"];
    const rows = currentClinicalPrograms.flatMap((program) => {
      const drug = drugById.get(program.drug_id);
      const target = targetById.get(program.primary_target_id);
      const trials = (trialsByProgram.get(program.program_id) || []).map((trial) => trial.registry_identifier || trial.trial_id).join("; ");
      const base = [payload.release.version, payload.release.as_of_date, program.program_id, program.drug_id, drug?.preferred_name || drug?.generic_name || "", program.development_name, program.primary_target_id, target?.gene_symbol || "", target?.preferred_name || "", target?.protein_group || "Unclassified", target?.landscape_scope || "", program.target_status, program.indication_name, program.lifecycle_status, program.modality, program.inclusion_status, trials];
      return (outcomesByProgram.get(program.program_id) || [null]).map((outcome) => {
        const source = outcome ? sourceById.get(outcome.source_id) : null;
        return [...base, outcome?.outcome_event_id || "", outcome?.event_type || "", outcome?.event_date || "", outcome?.description || "", outcome?.stated_or_inferred || "", outcome?.confidence || "", outcome?.source_id || "", /^https:\/\//.test(source?.url || "") ? source.url : ""];
      });
    });
    downloadCsv("drug-target-clinical-pilot", headers, rows);
  });
})();
</script>
